verdicts.reason: A is the better resize. It uses a sensible left-to-right banner structure: headline and tagline on the left, the date block in the middle, and the chips and a prominent RSVP button on the right. Its flaws are that the logo is jammed into the top-left corner over the circle, the can floats on its own above the date, the 'missing asset' placeholder is clipped at the right, and the legal line nearly touches the bottom edge. B demotes the RSVP CTA to a chip the same size as the badges, so the call to action is buried. It also wraps the tagline into a narrow five-line column, splits the date from the time with a large gap, crams the tiny legal text and the placeholder into the right corner, and lets the oversized two-line headline compete with everything, so the reading order is jumbled.
